scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter orcabot-worker build && concurrently -k "pnpm --filter orcabot-cli dev worker run" "pnpm --filter @orcabot/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter orcabot-worker build && pnpm --filter @orcabot/web build && pnpm --filter orcabot-cli build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter orcabot-worker build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter orcabot-worker build && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts tests/cross-service/*.test.js
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
